name: 15227 · Pittsburgh, PA
findings: ZIP 15227 (Pittsburgh) has 75 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 15227 (Pittsburgh) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 15227 (Pittsburgh) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 30 organizations here; 37% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find public events now, including outside formal organizations?
